From shelf to sold in three steps

We've stripped away everything that makes selling books tedious. No typing titles. No scanning barcodes. No guessing prices.

Step 01

Scan your shelf

Pan your camera across your bookshelf. Our AI identifies every spine in real-time—typically 30 books in under 90 seconds.

Step 02

Review & price

We check live market data and suggest fair prices. Accept our recommendations or adjust them—you're in control.

Step 03

Ship & get paid

When a book sells, generate your £2.50 shipping label and drop it at any Yodel drop-off point — no printer needed. Payment lands in your account once delivered.

Why settle for pennies?

Trade-in services give you pocket change. We connect you directly with readers.
